warnings.clamped_to_minimum: Raised to a safe minimum. Below this it's hard to get enough nutrients.
warnings.fast_loss: A fast pace is hard to sustain and costs muscle along with fat. A moderate pace works better.
warnings.fast_gain: With fast gain, most of it is fat. A moderate pace builds more muscle.
warnings.underweight_loss: Your weight is already below normal (BMI < 18.5). Losing weight isn't recommended — talk to a doctor.
warnings.minor: Under 18 your needs are different. Talk to a doctor or coach before changing your diet.
